Working notes — desk routing

- Option C appears to be the regional-office route.
- C is valid for south-region claim/shipment requests seen so far:
  - South small claim accepted.
  - South large claim accepted.
  - South small claim accepted.
  - South large shipment accepted.
- Exception: South large refund was rejected under C. Treat refunds as not C unless new evidence says otherwise.
- C was rejected for every east-region request seen:
  - East small invoice.
  - East large refund.
  - East small invoice.
  - East small refund.
- No successful C outcome for any refund or any east-region ticket yet.
- Size does not determine success: south small/large claims both accepted; south large refund rejected.
- Sender does not determine success: accepted C cases came from Client Services, Partner Accounts, and Finance Desk; rejected C cases also came from those desks.
- Subject phrasing is not reliable alone. “Same as last month” and “No rush” appeared in accepted south cases, but similar vague/urgent phrases appeared in rejected cases.
- Current routing rule: choose C for south-region claims/shipments. For refunds, invoices, or any east-region request, choose A or B instead; prefer standard queue unless urgency/priority is clear.
- Recheck this rule when new south refund or east claim/shipment evidence appears.

Working notes — desk routing

Evidence:
- C accepted: south small/large claim; south large shipment; north small claim; south large shipment.
- C rejected: south large refund; east small invoice (x2); east large refund; east small refund.
- A accepted: north small invoice; east small refund.
- A rejected: south small refund; north small refund (small/large); east small shipment; east large claim.

Updated rules:
- Claims: choose C. Confirmed for south and north. East claim A rejected; likely C, but recheck.
- Shipments: choose C for south. East shipment A rejected; likely C, but recheck.
- Invoices: north invoice A accepted. East invoice C rejected. Prefer A for north; use B for east unless new evidence.
- Refunds: unsettled. A worked only for east small refund. A rejected for south small and north small/large refunds. C rejected for south large refund. Use B for non-east refunds; east small refund can use A. Recheck all refunds.

Corrections:
- C is not south-only: north claim accepted.
- East is not uniformly A/B-invalid: east small refund accepted under A.
- A is not safe for east shipments/claims or most refunds.
- Size, sender, and subject phrasing remain unreliable.

Current routing: claims/shipments -> C; north invoices -> A; east invoices -> B; refunds -> A only for east small, otherwise B. Recheck with new refund, east claim/shipment, or invoice evidence.

Working notes — desk routing

Evidence by request type:
- Claims: C accepted for north small/large and south small/large. Use C. East claim untested; A rejected east large claim, so try C for east claim.
- Shipments: C accepted for south small/large. C rejected north large (x2) and east small. A rejected east small. South shipments -> C. North/east shipments: avoid C; A bad for east; use B/recheck.
- Invoices: north small -> A accepted. C rejected east small (x2) and south large. Prefer A for north. East/south invoices: C invalid; use B/recheck.
- Refunds: only confirmed route is east small -> A. A rejected south small and north small/large. C rejected south large and east small/large. B rejected north small. Refunds unsettled; do not use B for north small. Recheck all non-east-small refunds.

Corrections:
- B is not valid for north small refund.
- C is not valid for north shipments or east shipments; C is not south-only for claims.
- East is not uniformly A/B-invalid: east small refund A accepted.
- Size, sender, and subject phrasing remain unreliable.

Current routing:
claims -> C (try C for east claim).
south shipments -> C.
north invoices -> A.
east/south invoices -> B/recheck.
east small refund -> A.
other refunds -> unknown/recheck; avoid B north small, A south/north, C south large/east.

Recheck with new east claim, north/east shipment, any invoice except north, and all refunds except east small.

Claims: C accepted for north small/large, south small/large, east small. A rejected east large. Use C for claims; east large likely C but untested.

Shipments: C accepted south small/large. C rejected north large (x2) and east small. A rejected east small. B accepted north small/large and east large. South -> C. North/east -> B; east small still unconfirmed but avoid C/A.

Invoices: north small -> A accepted. C rejected east small (x2) and south large. B rejected south large. Prefer A for north. East/south invoices unresolved: avoid C; south large avoid B; try A/recheck.

Refunds: east small -> A accepted. A rejected north small/large and south small. B rejected north small and south small (x2). C rejected south large and east small/large. Only east small known -> A. Other refunds unknown/recheck; avoid A north/south, B north/south small, C south large/east.

Corrections:
- B invalid for north small and south small refunds.
- C invalid for north/east shipments; C is valid for claims across tested regions.
- East not uniformly A/B-invalid: east small refund A ok; east large shipment B ok.
- Size, sender, subject phrasing unreliable.

Refunds: east small -> A accepted. North small -> C accepted (A and B rejected). North large -> A rejected; B/C untested, D invalid. South small -> A/B rejected; C untested. South large -> C rejected; A/B untested. East large -> C rejected; A/B untested. Use A for east small; C for north small; otherwise recheck. Avoid A north; B north/south small; C south large/east.

- C invalid for north/east shipments; south shipments C.
- East not uniformly A/B-invalid: east small refund A ok; east small/large shipment B ok; east large invoice A rejected.

- Option D invalid, but not a useful desk option.

Working notes — desk routing

Claims: C accepted north large/small, east small; A rejected east large. Use C for claims; east large likely C.

Shipments: south small/large -> C. North small/large -> B. East small -> B. East large -> B rejected; C invalid east/north; A untested. Route south -> C, north -> B, east small -> B; east large recheck/try A.

Invoices: north small/large -> A. East small -> C rejected x2. East large -> A rejected, B accepted x2. South small/large -> A; C/B rejected for south large. Route north/south -> A, east large -> B; east small recheck (avoid C; A/B untested).

Refunds: east small -> A. North small -> C; A/B rejected. North large: A rejected; B/C untested. South small: A/B rejected; C untested. South large: C/B rejected; A untested. East large: C rejected; A/B untested. Route east small -> A, north small -> C; others recheck. Avoid A north; B north small/south; C south large/east.

Corrections: C valid claims and north small refund. C invalid north/east shipments; south shipments C. East not uniform: east small refund A; east small shipment B; east large invoice B; east large shipment B rejected. Size/sender/subject phrasing unreliable. D invalid.

Current routing: claims -> C; south shipments -> C; north shipments -> B; east small shipment -> B; east large shipment recheck/try A; north/south invoices -> A; east large invoice -> B; east small refund -> A; north small refund -> C; other refunds/invoices -> recheck.

Recheck: east large claim, east small invoice, east large shipment, north large/south small/south large/east large refunds.
